item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem:
The diagram shows Kabir's choices for heating dal: an iron pan, a wooden handle, and a shiny plastic pan. He must pick a pan to heat the dal and a handle for a hot iron pan.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: An iron pan is suitable for heating dal because iron conducts heat well.
options.B: An iron handle is safer than a wooden handle on the hot iron pan.
options.C: A wooden handle becomes a good heat conductor when fixed to the iron pan.
options.D: Shiny plastic is suitable for a heating pan because it conducts heat well.
